title: Zesty Malted Italian Wholemeal Flour Risotto
description: A malty and shattering Italian dish featuring strong wholemeal flour, this risotto is a unique and flavorful experience, inspired by the Ligurian region and monsoon Italian cuisine, and is shojin-friendly, meaning it is suitable for a Buddhist vegetarian diet. This recipe is also broiled to perfection.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the wholemeal flour and malted barley flour, stirring constantly for 1 minute.
Add the white wine and cook until the liquid is almost completely absorbed.
Add 1/2 cup of warm vegetable broth to the saucepan and stir until absorbed, repeat this process until all the broth is used.
Transfer the saucepan to the preheated oven and broil for 2-3 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Remove the saucepan from the oven and stir in the Grana Padano cheese until melted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
